changes.diff_text:
+The 2026 State of the API Report: agents are in production, and most APIs aren’t ready
+Abhinav Asthana
+The 2026 State of the API Report: 1 in 4 orgs run AI agents in production, but only 13.2% say their APIs are fully ready. See the data and what to do next.
+Read more →
+How to Write Postman Performance Test Scripts That Scale
+abhishek singhal
+Learn how to write Postman performance test scripts: chain requests, add assertions, sign in with setup collections, feed data, and debug before scaling load.
+Read more →
-Sharing API Simulations Across Coding Agent Sessions
-Harsh Vardhan
-How to use Postman simulations so coding agents stop rebuilding the same mocks and troubleshooting the same dependencies. Try it with the Postman CLI.
-Read more →
-One Terminal, Entire Agentic SDLC: Live Nov 17 at 10 AM PST
-Talia Kohan
-Join our live agentic SDLC webinar on Nov 17. See the Postman plugin take one API change from dependency discovery to CI.
-Read more →
